snippet.title: Arena Breakout: Infinite Full Release on Steam & Epic Games SEP. 15 | Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
THE WAIT IS OVER!

We're ready for the full release on Steam & Epic Games on September 15! This version delivers a more complete extraction shooter experience, along with several milestone changes:
- Direct Koen purchases have been removed
- A free 3x3 Titanium Case will be available through in-game tasks

We're also opening Season 3: Breach. New Seasonal contents are added including trophy room 2.0, weapons, launch bonuses...

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073620

#ArenaBreakoutPC #ArenaBreakoutInfinite #ABIFullRelease
